title: Agent Socket: one link, any agent, as a patch switchboard
author: repalash
prompt: Draw the relay behind Agent Socket as a real object: a small patch switchboard on a bench plate. Three callers (a server rack, a terminal, a tape reader) are AI agents; patch cords into the switchboard's sockets are links to a laptop (a browser tab) and an app. Interactive: pull a plug to end a link, close the laptop and the switchboard holds the line.
